svg.title: Apache Pulsar event-driven architecture
svg.desc: Event-driven architecture for Apache Pulsar: producers publish messages to topics; brokers route and persist to BookKeeper; consumers receive via subscriptions independently; Pulsar Functions process events in-stream; source/sink connectors integrate external systems. Producers and consumers fully decoupled through durable topics and subscriptions.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do application producers publish messages to Pulsar topics?')
sendPrompt('How do Pulsar source connectors produce events?')
sendPrompt('Can Pulsar Functions act as producers?')

g.text: Pulsar brokers — stateless routing and serving
Route messages · enforce subscriptions · serve consumers · manage topic ownership

g.text: Replicated ledger entries · per-topic partitions · replay from any offset

g.text: Sink connectors — deliver to external systems
Elasticsearch · Cassandra · Kafka · S3 · JDBC · custom sinks

svg.text: Producers never invoke consumer logic — fully decoupled through durable topics, subscriptions, and broker delivery
